notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hello friends!
[olist]
We've been hard at work making a demo version of Vega Chronicle so that folks can start playing and give us feedback to help shape the game. It's almost ready! 

We overhauled the Steam page: go check out the new descriptions, screenshots and gameplay video :)

Here's a new gif  <3
[/olist]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/8258e172e51faf3645179790853f981dda8c36d1.gif"]

notes.title: Victory conditions update
notes.content:
This week we added multiple victory conditions. Choose your path to glory:
[olist]
"Development": Build nexuses in 1/3 of the galaxy's star systems.

"Science": Complete the technology tree and research Existential manipulation.

"Culture": Construct 5 monuments.

"Elimination": Destroy all rival civilizations.
[/olist]
Here's a sneak peek at some of the ships you can build in Vega Chronicle:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/dc30031a4181afffaf7ded6c7e592c7d7fdf6c35.png"]

notes.title: Diplomacy and trade update
notes.content:
Hello friends!
[olist]
This week we built a diplomacy system where you can trade and negotiate with other space-faring civilizations. We also added more music and sound effects.

We set a goal to start play-testing the demo by the second week of July: we'll be asking for your help!

Here's a sneak-peek at the diplomacy interface:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/c2f94a62d42cb67a7b2248a4d5808c1d8c7c593c.png"]
[/olist]
